time.expression: Regev-type polynomial-time quantum circuits and polynomial classical post-processing

notes: Extension of Regev’s method to prime-field discrete logarithms. Circuit size per run, repetitions, arithmetic implementation and post-processing are separate resources. The original construction uses number-theoretic heuristic assumptions; later unconditional variants are analysed by Pilatte.
